EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT NOTE St. Eadburh's Medical Center Emergency Department Arrival 10/10/2074 17:48 Triage ESI 3 Room ED-14 Patient: Tadeusz Wieczorek MRN WK-6620931 DOB 11/09/2026 47 y/o M ED attending: Dr. Kenji Oyelaran RN: Brigid Fontaine
S: 47 yo man restrained driver, rear-ended at a red light on Pacific Ave about 1 hr before arrival. Car: grey sedan plate BKM 6215, other driver gave insurance info to police, report # TPD-74-118820. Immediate neck pain and stiffness, headache, no LOC, no vomiting, denies numbness or weakness. Hx chronic low back and neck pain (since 2069), previously on long-acting opioids until Feb 2072, now only acetaminophen. Obesity. PMH also notes partner abuse hx, pt states he is safe at home now. Father had Parkinson's disease, uncle Hodgkin lymphoma - not relevant today. NKDA. O: Vitals T 36.9 HR 88 BP 142/88 (pain) RR 16 SpO2 98% RA. Wt 109.1 kg. Alert, GCS 15. C-spine tender paraspinal mucles, no midline step-off, ROM limited by pain. Neuro intact, no Bell's palsy, no facial droop. Spurling neg. CT c-spine neg for fracture. Lungs clear, abd soft nontender, seatbelt sign absent. A: Cervical strain / whiplash injury of neck, MVC. P: acetaminophen 325 mg q6h prn (Tylenol ok), NO opioids per pt request and hx; heat, gentle ROM, soft collar not advised. Rtc if worse. Pt asked us to page his friend Desmond Achebe to pick him up, ph 253-555-0148. Ill page ortho only if sx persist. Seen with Dr. Oyelaran. Dc'd 10/10/2074 21:15 in stable condition.
Electronically signed by Kenji Oyelaran, MD on 10/10/2074 21:40 WIECZOREK, TADEUSZ MRN WK-6620931 Page 2 of 2
